summary: REDACTED: this run's portfolio summary names a project that is private by rule. Full detail is in the constellation report; withheld from the public copy.

topActions.label: Upload the personal-skills plugin package in the desktop application, so the snapshot every headless session loads stops running a fourteen-skill-stale copy whose git recovery instructions still tell a session to delete a lock by hand.
Run the project-pages updater so every homepage card re-stamps from its own status file, then find why per-release stamping fell behind on four live projects at once.
Run the Here Be Hordes release, or commit the nine touched files with an explicit path list, so five verified fixes stop existing only in one working tree.
Cancel only the subscription that a refunded charge names in the Chains webhook, instead of walking every non-terminal row on that customer; today one refund revokes everything the person pays for.
Drop the Gnosis questions minted past the three-a-day ceiling out of the vault and confirm a clean build, so the release script can get past its own gate again; never raise that limit to clear it.
Rewrite the three public files that name the private manuscript, its sale intent and its local source path, so they describe the gate mechanism without naming the work.

Fix both faults in the Chains migrations before either is pasted into the database editor: a soft-delete column with no matching update policy, and a timestamp that takes its default ahead of the backfill meant to populate it.
Make the three Gnosis key-value writers fail closed after a failed read, instead of putting a near-empty map over everyone's data.
Delete the five stray text fragments inside the Chains page head, which end it early and render as visible words ahead of the real header on the live site.
